sentences.Hawa kommer for sent til språkpraksis i: Hawa is late for her language placement today.
She runs in to her colleague Rune.
sentences.Unnskyld at jeg kommer for sent. Jeg for: Sorry I'm late. I overslept and missed the bus.
sentences.Det gjorde du i forrige uke også!: You did that last week too!
sentences.Huff, jeg vet det, men bussen går bare é: Oh dear, I know, but the bus only goes once an hour.
sentences.Det er viktig å komme presis. Sjefen bli: It's important to be on time. The boss won't be happy, and you could lose the job.
sentences.Jeg vet det, men det er vanskelig å stå: I know, but it's hard to get up so early.
Thanks! I'll never oversleep again. I want to get a driving licence and buy a car.
It's expensive to get your licence in Norway.
Yes, I have to save money.
sentences.Jeg har bil, men jeg sykler ofte til job: I have a car, but I often cycle to work. I like cycling. It only takes 20 minutes. It's healthy and free, and it's good for the environment. In winter I take the bus now and then.
sentences.Jeg har ikke sykkel, og jeg har ikke råd: I don't have a bike, and I can't afford a car and a driving licence now. But I can surely afford to buy a second-hand bike. That's what I'll do!
sentences.En dag i uka har Hawa språkpraksis på ho: One day a week Hawa has a language placement at the hotel.
sentences.I dag kommer hun for sent, for hun forso: Today she is late, because she overslept and missed the bus.
sentences.Hawa liker ikke å stå opp tidlig og fors: Hawa doesn't like getting up early and often oversleeps.
She wants to get a driving licence, but it's expensive.
sentences.Kollegaen Rune har førerkort og bil, men: Her colleague Rune has a driving licence and a car, but he usually cycles to work.
sentences.Han sparer penger, og det er sunt å sykl: He saves money, and cycling is healthy.
sentences.Hawa har lyst til å kjøpe en brukt sykke: Hawa wants to buy a second-hand bike.
